quickCapture.failed: Clipboard capture could not be completed.

commandPalette.title: Command palette
commandPalette.description: Search available application commands, then use the arrow keys and Enter to run one.

snippet.selectHint: Select a snippet to start editing
snippet.title: Title...
snippet.tags: Type a tag and press Enter, or pick from suggestions...
snippet.loadUnavailable: The code editor is unavailable right now.
snippet.loadUnavailableDevHint: Restart the Vite development server, then retry loading the editor.
snippet.minimapResize: Drag to resize the decorative code minimap
snippet.historyDescription: Review saved local and synchronized revisions in a dedicated workspace. Restoring creates a new local revision and does not start synchronization.
snippet.historyWindowUnavailable: Revision history is unavailable right now. Close the window and try opening History again from the editor.
snippet.historyRestoreFailed: The restore request could not be completed. The current revision was left unchanged.
snippet.historyEmpty: No saved revision history is available.
snippet.deletedRevisionDescription: This tombstone was created at {{time}}. Its deleted content cannot be restored in this version.
snippet.restoreRevisionConfirm: Restore this saved revision? Its fields and code will become a new local revision. Your current version remains in history and no synchronization starts automatically.
snippet.compareDeletedDescription: This revision is a tombstone. It has no source content to compare or restore.
snippet.compareBothDeleted: Neither selected revision contains source content.
snippet.compareIdentical: The revisions have identical source ({{count}} line(s)).

compareLimited.size: Detailed line comparison is unavailable for this revision pair because it exceeds the local size limit. The full source remains available side by side.
compareLimited.complexity: Detailed line comparison is unavailable for this highly divergent revision pair. The full source remains available side by side.
compareLimited.time: Detailed line comparison reached the local work limit. The full source remains available side by side.

settings.title: Settings
settings.unsavedChanges: These settings have unsaved changes. Save before closing?
settings.changedExternally: Saved settings changed elsewhere. Your unsaved fields have been kept; saving will apply this draft.
settings.autoSyncTimingNote: The first automatic sync may run shortly after enabling. Later attempts follow the selected interval.
settings.backgroundSyncSuccess: Background sync completed and the latest snippets were refreshed.
settings.webdavDesc: Secure two-way WebDAV merge. HTTPS is required except for localhost, 127.0.0.1, and ::1 development servers.
settings.autoStartDesc: Automatically launch when you log in
settings.minimizeToTrayDesc: Clicking the close button minimizes to the system tray
settings.accentPresetDesc: After saving, changes the app background, panels, cards, titlebar, dialogs, controls, editor chrome, and minimap. Minimal White restores the neutral light/dark surfaces from the first version. Syntax and language colors stay unchanged.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the display language for the app interface

secretAction.replace: Saving will replace the stored credential. The existing value is never shown here.
secretAction.clear: Saving will remove the stored credential and disable credential-backed auto-sync until replaced.

credentialStatus.configured: A credential is stored by the operating system. Leave this field blank to keep it.
credentialStatus.not_configured: No credential is stored. Enter one if the selected authentication mode requires it.
credentialStatus.unavailable: The operating-system credential store is unavailable. Unlock or repair it, then replace or clear the credential.
credentialStatus.denied: Credential access was denied. Grant access, then replace or clear the credential.
credentialStatus.invalid: The credential entry is invalid. Replace or clear it.
credentialStatus.ambiguous: Multiple matching credential entries were found. Clear the duplicates, then replace or clear here.
credentialStatus.migration_required: A legacy credential could not be migrated. The original settings file is preserved; replace or clear the credential before auto-sync resumes.
credentialStatus.recovery_required: A rollback could not be completed. Review the operating-system credential and startup settings, then replace or clear the credential.

recovery.backup_restored: The primary settings file was damaged and quarantined; a valid backup was restored.
recovery.defaults_loaded: The settings file was damaged and quarantined, no valid backup was available, and safe defaults were loaded.

settings.webdavAuthModeDesc: Auto by default (Digest→Basic); switch based on your server
settings.autoSyncDesc: Automatically sync at the set interval
settings.syncResultCounts: {{total}} total · {{uploaded}} up · {{downloaded}} down · {{deleted}} deleted · {{conflicts}} conflicts · {{pending}} pending
settings.localSnapshotsDesc: Creates verified full-vault SQLite checkpoints on this device. Snapshots do not include settings or operating-system credentials and are never sent to WebDAV.
settings.localSnapshotsEnabledDesc: Create complete local vault checkpoints on the selected schedule.
settings.localSnapshotFrequencyDesc: The scheduler checks this policy while SnipVault is running.
settings.localSnapshotRetentionDesc: Verified snapshots kept on this device before the oldest cataloged checkpoint is removed.
settings.syncConfirm: WebDAV v2 two-way merge sync will run: local and remote revisions are merged through the revision/outbox journal, deletions propagate as tombstones, and concurrent branches keep conflict copies. Continue?
settings.aboutValueDesc: Local code snippet manager with multi-language syntax highlighting, search, and WebDAV sync

snapshots.title: Snapshots and restore
snapshots.description: Verified local SQLite checkpoints for this device. Snapshot files are not synchronized or exported.
snapshots.empty: No local snapshots yet. Create one now or enable the scheduled policy in Settings.
snapshots.restoreScope: Restoring replaces the complete local vault represented by the selected checkpoint. SnipVault verifies it and creates a new emergency checkpoint before changing the active database.
snapshots.scopeDatabase: Includes snippets, search index, revision history, pending synchronization work, local usage, and device identity.
snapshots.scopeExcluded: Does not change Settings or operating-system WebDAV credentials.
snapshots.scopeManualSync: Pauses scheduled WebDAV synchronization after restore. Review the restored vault, then start a manual synchronization from the toolbar, Settings, or system tray when ready.
snapshots.restoreWarning: This is a high-impact local replacement. Review the selected checkpoint before continuing.
snapshots.selectSnapshot: Choose an available checkpoint to inspect and restore.
snapshots.restoreConfirm: Restore the selected full-vault checkpoint? SnipVault will create an emergency checkpoint first. This replaces local snippets, history, pending synchronization work, local usage, and device identity. Settings and credentials remain untouched. Scheduled synchronization will be paused until a later manual synchronization from the toolbar, Settings, or system tray succeeds.
snapshots.restoreComplete: The local vault was restored successfully. Scheduled WebDAV synchronization is paused; review the restored state, then synchronize manually from the toolbar, Settings, or system tray when ready.

syncNotifications.title: Sync notifications
syncNotifications.description: A de-identified record of local synchronization outcomes. It never stores server addresses, credentials, snippet content, revision IDs, or remote responses.
syncNotifications.pendingSummary: Synchronization completed with {{count}} pending local revision(s).
syncNotifications.failureSummary: Synchronization did not complete. Review the connection and settings before trying again.
syncNotifications.busySummary: Another synchronization operation is already running.
syncNotifications.restoreRequired: A local vault restore paused scheduled synchronization. Review the restored state, then start a manual synchronization when ready.

dialog.title: Confirm
dialog.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this snippet?
dialog.confirmBulkDelete: Delete {{count}} selected snippets? This cannot be undone.

sidebar.emptyHint: Click New above to create one

commandErrors.not_found: The requested item could not be found.
commandErrors.stale_revision: This snippet changed since the draft was loaded. Your draft was preserved; reload before saving again.
commandErrors.outbox_full: The pending synchronization queue reached its safety limit. Synchronize or free space before editing more snippets.
commandErrors.database: The local database operation failed. Please retry.
commandErrors.settings: The settings operation failed. Please retry.
commandErrors.network: The network or synchronization request failed. Please retry.
commandErrors.sync_busy: Another synchronization is already running. Please wait and retry.
commandErrors.sync_cas_conflict: The remote vault changed while publishing. Retry synchronization to reconcile the latest generation.
commandErrors.sync_legacy_changed: Legacy WebDAV data changed during the one-way v2 upgrade. Retry after other clients stop writing.
commandErrors.import: The snippet import could not be completed.
commandErrors.export: The snippet export could not be completed.
commandErrors.autostart: The startup setting could not be changed.
commandErrors.credential: The operating-system credential store could not complete the request.
commandErrors.recovery: The change could not be fully rolled back. Open Settings and follow the recovery guidance.
commandErrors.snapshot: The local snapshot operation could not be completed. The active vault was kept safe.
commandErrors.open: The trusted location could not be opened.
commandErrors.unknown: The operation could not be completed.

errors.exportSuccessDownloads: Export successful. File saved to your Downloads folder.
errors.exportSuccessFallback: Export successful. Downloads unavailable, file saved to app data folder.
errors.bulkMutationFailed: The bulk change could not be completed: {{error}}
errors.reloadAfterMutationFailed: The change was saved, but the latest snippets could not be reloaded: {{error}}
errors.reloadAfterSyncFailed: Sync completed, but the latest local state could not be reloaded: {{error}}
errors.reloadAfterRestoreFailed: The local vault was restored, but the latest interface state could not be reloaded: {{error}}
errors.remoteUpdateApplied: The selected snippet was refreshed with the latest saved data.
errors.remoteUpdatePending: New saved data is available. Your unsaved edits were preserved.
errors.loadDetailFailed: The snippet could not be loaded: {{error}}
errors.noWebdav: Please configure WebDAV server address in Settings first
